newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-DALIAN HELD IN CHINA LEAGUE, STAY TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DALIAN HELD IN CHINA LEAGUE, STAY TOP.

text.p: Dalian Wanda, defending champions in the China soccer league, were held to a 1-1 draw on Sunday by the 11th-ranked army team, August 1, the Xinhua news agency said.
Beijing Guo'an recovered from a 5-1 defeat to Dalian last week to hammer Shanghai Shenhua 9-1 at home. Beijing dominated the match, with three of its foreign players scoring eight of the nine goals.
The home players had built up a 5-1 lead in the first half and never relaxed their grip, Xinhua said.
"It was unexpected scoring tonight," said chief coach Jin Zhiyang.
The win promoted Beijing from fourth spot to second in the league standings after 10 rounds.
Dalian, top of the standings since the start of the season, kept its unbeaten record although it was forced to a 1-1 tie by August 1.
In three other drawn matches, Yanbian Aodong drew Guangzhou Apollo 0-0, Jinan Taishan held Vanguard Huandao 2-2 and Sichuan Quanxing tied Qingdao Hainiu 1-1.
